args: Refund rate on points-redeeming orders vs other member orders

Among loyalty members' own orders, do the ones where loyalty points were actually redeemed show a higher refund rate than their other orders - i.e. is the elevated member refund rate concentrated in reward-redeeming purchases, suggesting rewards are being used without real purchase intent?
